cpu_reference.precision: float input/output with double FFTW and double intermediate accumulation
cpu_reference.scope: FFTW_ESTIMATE plan creation, 10x 128x128 SOCS reconstruction, 128-to-1024 Fourier interpolation, and final 1024x1024 float output formation
cpu_reference.excluded: input loading, mask FFT, kernel extraction, logging, PNG and binary file writing

resident_inputs.scope: ap_start/ap_done busy-poll, C2H 128x128 output, Host 128-to-1024 FI

retransmit_inputs.scope: H2C mask/kernels/scales, output clear, AXI-Lite configuration, ap_start/ap_done busy-poll, C2H output, Host FI

comparison_caution: CPU and FPGA both form 1024x1024 outputs, but the CPU reference consumes host-resident arrays while the FPGA retransmit scenario additionally includes PCIe input movement and AXI-Lite configuration.
